kids.zh: 我们主要看到的发光薄层，不是坚实表面。
kids.en: The thin luminous layer we mainly see, not solid ground.

science.zh: 我们主要看到的发光薄层，不是坚实表面。 层厚与颜色为教学示意。
science.en: The thin luminous layer we mainly see, not solid ground. Thicknesses and colors are schematic.

kids.zh: 热的等离子体上升，较冷的物质下沉。
kids.en: Hot plasma rises while cooler material sinks.

science.zh: 热的等离子体上升，较冷的物质下沉。 层厚与颜色为教学示意。
science.en: Hot plasma rises while cooler material sinks. Thicknesses and colors are schematic.

kids.zh: 能量通过辐射缓慢向外传递。
kids.en: Energy travels slowly outward through radiation.

science.zh: 能量通过辐射缓慢向外传递。 层厚与颜色为教学示意。
science.en: Energy travels slowly outward through radiation. Thicknesses and colors are schematic.

kids.en: Hydrogen fuses into helium, releasing energy.

science.zh: 氢聚变成氦，释放能量。 层厚与颜色为教学示意。
science.en: Hydrogen fuses into helium, releasing energy. Thicknesses and colors are schematic.

summary.zh: 太阳内部的能量向外传递。
summary.en: Energy travels outward from the solar interior.

evidence.zh: 太阳内部通过物理模型和日震学推断，不是透视照片。
evidence.en: Solar interiors are inferred through physical models and helioseismology, not photographed.
